headline: Swan Realty launches luxury 'Bodhi' project in Bengaluru
summary: Swan Realty, the real estate arm of Swan Corp Limited, has launched 'Bodhi', a low-density luxury residential project in Jayanagar, Bengaluru. The project features 24 four-bedroom residences designed by Kembhavi Architecture Foundation.

summary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited has signed an exclusive MoU with Munitions India Limited to integrate and manufacture indigenous 155 mm artillery course-correction fuzes, supporting Atmanirbhar Bharat goals.

headline: GMR Airports launches real estate subsidiary
summary: GMR Airports incorporated GMR Aero Realty Limited with ₹1 crore capital to pursue land development and real estate opportunities.

headline: Biocon secures launch dates for Pebrilzo
summary: Biocon Limited enters global patent settlement with Genentech, securing earliest licensed launch dates for its biosimilar Pebrilzo in EU, UK, and US.

headline: Swan Realty launches Bodhi project in Bengaluru
summary: Swan Realty has launched its premium 'Bodhi' housing project in Jayanagar, Bengaluru, with completion targeted by March 2028.

headline: B R Shetty sues Bank of Baroda for $15 billion
summary: B R Shetty has filed a $15 billion lawsuit against Bank of Baroda and 25 others in the Bombay High Court, marking one of the largest civil suits in Indian legal history.

headline: Ircon International plans to sell four highway assets
summary: Ircon International plans to divest four highway assets to unlock ₹3,000 crore in value, signalling a strategic move to monetise its road infrastructure portfolio.

headline: Indian rupee opens at 95.01 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 95.01 against the US dollar, strengthening from the previous close of 95.28, reflecting a gain in the domestic currency.

headline: JSW Steel block trade of ₹65.62 crore on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 5,63,126 shares of JSW Steel was executed on the NSE at ₹1,165.30 per share, amounting to ₹65.62 crore.

headline: Poonawalla Fincorp shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~15,07,631 Poonawalla Fincorp shares changing hands on NSE at ₹438.10, with a combined value of ₹66.05 crore.

headline: Income Tax Department searches Park Medi World
summary: The Income Tax Department conducted search operations at Park Medi World. The development marks a significant regulatory action against the company.

headline: Max Healthcare block trade of ₹31.70 crore on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 369,416 shares of Max Healthcare Institute was executed on BSE at ₹858.00 per share, aggregating to ₹31.70 crore.

headline: Tata Power builds 2.8 GW data centre pipeline
summary: Tata Power reports a 2.8 GW opportunity pipeline across 18 data centre players, engaging in 29 active workstreams to support India's AI and digital growth.

headline: Craftsman Automation sets earnings call for Oct 29
summary: Craftsman Automation will host an earnings call on October 29, 2026, to discuss Q1FY27 financial results. Management participation includes CMD Srinivasan Ravi.

headline: ACIF-1 exits Ponni Sugars stake via open market
summary: ACIF-1 sold its entire 5.81% holding in Ponni Sugars (Erode) Ltd, comprising 5 lakh shares, through open market transactions between October 5 and 13, 2026.

headline: Kotak MF crosses 5% stake in MV Electrosystems
summary: Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund acquired 1 lakh shares of MV Electrosystems Ltd on October 9, 2026, raising its holding to 5.04% via open market transactions.

headline: Kotak MF crosses 5% stake in Lohia Corp
summary: Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund acquired 337,058 shares of Lohia Corp Limited, pushing its holding to 5.2883%. The acquisition was made via open market transactions on October 9, 2026.

headline: JK Paper promoter group consolidates stake via scheme
summary: YPL Enterprises' stake in JK Paper rises to 7.06% as shares from four affiliated entities transfer under a composite scheme of arrangement effective October 12, 2026.

headline: Go Digit block trades worth ₹125.8 crore on BSE and NSE
summary: Go Digit General Insurance saw block trades totaling ₹125.8 crore across BSE and NSE, involving over 44 lakh shares at approximately ₹280 per share.

headline: Mumbai Metro partners with MapMyIndia for real-time data
summary: Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation has teamed up with C.E. Info Systems to deliver accurate real-time metro data through the MapMyIndia Mappls app, enhancing commuter navigation.

headline: YPL Enterprises stake in Bengal & Assam rises to 22.57%
summary: YPL Enterprises Private Limited increased its shareholding in Bengal & Assam Company Ltd to 22.57% via a Composite Scheme of Arrangement, consolidating promoter group holdings.

headline: Jyothy Labs to host Q2FY27 analyst call on Nov 4
summary: Jyothy Laboratories will hold a conference call for analysts and investors on November 4, 2026, to discuss financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Onix Renewable raises stake in Onix Solar to 51.73%
summary: Onix Renewable Limited acquired 7.46 lakh shares of Onix Solar Energy Ltd in the open market, increasing its holding to 51.73% as of October 13, 2026.

headline: Shellz India IPO DRHP Filed
summary: Shellz India Limited files DRHP for a fresh issue of ₹45 crore. FY2026 net profit stood at ₹13.37 crore with 59.52% CAGR.

headline: Rajasthan Tube postpones Q2FY27 board meeting
summary: Rajasthan Tube Manufacturing Company Limited postponed its board meeting scheduled for October 14, 2026, to consider standalone unaudited financial results for H1FY27.

headline: Aurionpro wins Matkahuolto cEMV deal in Finland
summary: Aurionpro Solutions selected by Matkahuolto for contactless EMV project in Finland, marking its entry into the European transit market.

headline: Modi Naturals cancels analyst meetings
summary: Modi Naturals Ltd cancelled scheduled analyst and institutional investor meetings on October 14, 2026, citing business exigencies. The cancellation was filed with BSE and NSE under SEBI regulations.

headline: IndusInd Bank block trade of ₹70.16 crore on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 799,745 shares of IndusInd Bank was executed on the BSE at ₹877.30 per share, amounting to ₹70.16 crore.

headline: Gland Pharma block trade of ₹71.91 crore on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 235,000 shares of Gland Pharma was executed on BSE at ₹3060.00 per share, aggregating to ₹71.91 crore.

headline: Navkar Corporation wins ₹48 crore cargo terminal deal
summary: Navkar Corporation received approval for construction of a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal, with the contract valued at around ₹48 crore.

headline: Marble City India approves preferential warrants
summary: Marble City India Limited approved a special resolution for issuing convertible warrants to non-promoters on a preferential basis during its EGM on October 14, 2026.

headline: Ravita Engineering IPO Day 1: 0.11x subscription
summary: Ravita Engineering Services IPO opened on 14 Oct 2026 with total subscription at 0.11x on Day 1. Retail leads at 0.17x; QIB demand absent so far. Price band ₹105–₹112.

headline: Mini Diamonds allots 1.11 crore warrants to promoters
summary: Mini Diamonds (India) Ltd allotted 1.11 crore convertible warrants to promoter group entities at ₹8 per warrant via preferential issue, raising ₹2.22 crore upfront.

headline: MTNL pays ₹7 lakh TRAI penalty for QoS violations
summary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd received orders from TRAI for financial disincentives totaling ₹7 lakh due to quality of service violations in wireline and wireless access services.

headline: TCS wins MyState Bank core banking deal
summary: Tata Consultancy Services selected by MyState Limited to deploy TCS BaNCS platform, supporting post-merger integration with Auswide Bank and AI-enabled operations.
